name: Keibiin ~Yuganda Shokumu Nisshi~
original_name: 警備員～歪んだ職務日誌～
source:
Main character is a guard in a department store. All the shoplifters should pay for their crimes, this way or another...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一家百货公司的警卫。所有的商店扒手都应该为他们的罪行付出代价，无论怎样……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
